integrity: Exact rational state-space tests support but do not replace the complete analytical argument. No independent external audit or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers synchronous independent fair-tie random-majority dynamics on the triangular books with an even number of leaves, not odd leaf counts, asynchronous updates, tie-retention, arbitrary graphs, or all possible priority literature. Infinite-size assertions follow from the analytic proof, not the finite computational checker.
title: A complete absorption law for random-majority opinion dynamics on triangular books
